name: Pouch
storyline:
You are a mouse on a mission.

The mission? Throw the best birthday party possible for your loving mouse mom. Raising a mouse as energetic as you in a cluttered and messy dorm room hasn't been easy, so let's give her the celebration she deserves!

There's only 7 days left to prepare and zero things ready for the party, so grab your pouch and stretch your little legs because it's time to get collecting!
summary: Pouch is a 3D open-world platformer where you play as a resourceful mouse, scavenging for supplies on your party-planning checklist. Explore the room, collect items, and bring them to your mailbox to get all the items on your list before the party! But be sure to make it back home in time each day-- you don't want to get caught by your giant, unfriendly neighbor.
